race.description: Rob Young Memorial Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: OCCUPATION (4) relished the jump in trip at his second race start with an eye-catching second over 1410m at Grafton. Finds a suitable race and will be savaging the line late. Expected to go close. HABIB ALBI (2) comes here deep into the campaign and is expected to go close in this easier contest. Stalked the speed when he finished a close-up fourth over 1509m at Port Macquarie. Trained locally and shapes as a solid each-way prospect. ANTONUCCI (8) is holding her form this prep and is on a seven-day back-up after finishing third over 1509m at Port Macquarie. Maps well again and has the ratings to take this out. LA REGINA (13) kept fresh with a battling seventh over 1175m at Grafton. Goes well on her home track and the extra trip will help her cause.
